questions.stem: Explain why denormalisation might be chosen over a fully normalised schema in a high-traffic web application.
markingGuide: Denormalisation reduces the need for complex joins, improving read performance.
High-traffic applications benefit from faster query execution, reducing load times.
The trade-off includes managing increased redundancy and potential update anomalies.

questions.stem: Discuss the trade-offs involved in denormalising a database used for reporting purposes.
markingGuide: Denormalisation can improve read performance by reducing the need for joins.
It introduces redundancy, which can lead to update anomalies.
Increased storage requirements due to redundant data.
Complexity in maintaining data consistency across redundant fields.
